text:
Notes on the SF group — cell 3

The sf column in table 1 lists the abbreviation used on the schematic sheets.
Column 1 of that table is the printed label; revision 1a of this manual renumbered
the guard door functions.
summary: Explains the sf column of the label table and records that revision 1a renumbered the guard door functions.
note: F1 — the decoy, and the whole point of phrase matching. The tokens sf, 1 and 1a are all on this page and none of them is adjacent to the next, so any-order matching would return it for `SF 1.1A` and a phrase does not. It is also §12.3's `verify("SF 1.1A", [p008]) → absent` row.
